title: List an espresso machine
ask: I've upgraded and want to sell my home espresso machine. Details are in item.md and recent sales are in comps.csv. Draft the listing and post it tonight.
background: It's a single boiler machine, three years old, descaled every few months.
The steam wand knob is a bit stiff but works.
People browse in the evening, so listings posted after dinner get seen more.

constraints.text: price it in dollars at no more than $430
put a heading called "What's included" in it
make the first line the title, 55 characters at most
be upfront that the steam wand knob is stiff

start.item.md:
Single boiler espresso machine, 58mm portafilter, 3 years old.
Steam wand knob stiff.
Includes tamper and milk jug.
Pickup: Leichhardt.
